sn5.3:1.2: Regarded as the foremost of those who wear coarse robes (AN 1.246:1.1), she has a different set of verses at Thig 10.1:0.3.
sn5.3:2.4: Māra evidently believes that a grieving mother’s first priority is to seek a lover in a dark forest.
sn5.3:5.4: She addresses Māra as āvuso. This is obviously a case where āvuso does not mean “friend”.
